title: "I'm fine." Five directions for an actor who doesn't exist
caption:
Same two words. Five directions. One actor who doesn't exist.

Every person on screen is AI-generated; nothing was filmed on set. Each take was directed beat by beat: when she breathes, when her chin shakes, when the sneeze lands.

What should Take 6 be? Write the direction in the comments.

SYNK PULSE directs AI models to act, for ads and brand films.
